question: Where must the twenty-syllabled mantra be uttered in relation to the name?
premises: The mantra is to be uttered.
Its placement is in the middle of the name.
inference: The twenty-syllabled mantra must be uttered in the middle of the name.
uncertainties: nāmnomadhye shows sandhi fusion of nāmno + madhye
plain_english: O eternal one, having uttered the twenty-syllabled mantra in the middle of the name.
